question.:question/problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/generate/scratch/17592186152187/plots/6c02d40bbc19e82bddbfc14b0286673b5dff92df7f25bacacf97e8a7d554e4b1.png)

Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for $\theta \in [0,2\pi ),$ generate the ellipse shown above?
question.:question/worked-solution:
The parametric equations of an ellipse centered at the origin with a horizontal radius of length $a$ and a vertical radius of length $b$ are

$$
x=a\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta ,\,y=b\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta ,\,\theta \in [0,2\pi ).
$$

In our case, $a=8$ and $b=2.$ Therefore, the parametric equations of the ellipse are

$$
x=8\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta ,\,y=2\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta ,\,\theta \in [0,2\pi ).
$$
